div.div: سَحَابٌ مُجَلِّلٌ Clouds that include the land in common, or generally, or universally, within the compass of their rain; i. e., that rain upon the land throughout its general, or universal extent: (S, TA:) or thundering clouds, covering the land with rain: (A, TA:) or clouds in which are thunder and lightning. (As, TA in art. قصب.) [See also مُجَلْجِلٌ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
